description: Returns the rules for one area of Spark: which tools to call in what order, what each one may and may not do, and the errors to expect. Call it before your first call in an area the server instructions list under WORKFLOW GUIDES, and follow what it says. Reads nothing from the account.

topic.description: The area, as the instructions' WORKFLOW GUIDES index names it: campaign_plans, sandbox_reset, simulation_workspaces, mission_control, purchase_order_lifecycle, receiving_and_stock, pick_pack_ship, invoices_and_quotes, returns, catalog_and_pricing, customer_price_lists, vendor_forecast_sharing, inventory_health_policy, tasks, hand_offs, pickup, reports, diagnostic_investigations.
